arguments.code:
phone_pw = next(a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='phone')
phone_number = '4436271690'
login_resp = apis.phone.login(username=phone_number, password=phone_pw)
access_token = login_resp['access_token']

# Fetch all alarms (paginated)
alarms=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if page is None or page==[]:
        break
    # API returns lists in this environment
    alarms.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break

print('fetched_alarm_count', len(alarms))
for al in alarms:
    print('alarm', {'alarm_id': al.get('alarm_id'), 'label': al.get('label'), 'time': al.get('time'), 'enabled': al.get('enabled'), 'repeat_days': al.get('repeat_days')})

# Select the go-to-sleep alarm
sleep_candidates = [al for al in alarms if al.get('label','').strip().lower() in ['go to sleep','go-to-sleep','go-to sleep','go to-sleep','go to sleep']]
if not sleep_candidates:
    # fallback: contains 'sleep'
    sleep_candidates = [al for al in alarms if 'sleep' in (al.get('label','').lower())]

print('sleep_candidates', [c.get('alarm_id') for c in sleep_candidates])
# Prefer exact label match; otherwise take the first candidate
sleep_alarm = None
for c in sleep_candidates:
    if c.get('label','').strip().lower()=='go to sleep':
        sleep_alarm=c
        break
if sleep_alarm is None:
    sleep_alarm = sleep_candidates[0]

sleep_id = sleep_alarm['alarm_id']
sleep_time = sleep_alarm['time']

# compute +1 hour
h,m = sleep_time.split(':')
new_h = int(h); new_m=int(m)
new_h = (new_h + 1) % 24
new_time = f"{new_h:02d}:{new_m:02d}"

# Build explicit action lists
others = [al for al in alarms if al.get('alarm_id') != sleep_id]
print('selected_sleep_alarm', {'alarm_id': sleep_id, 'old_time': sleep_time, 'new_time': new_time, 'repeat_days': sleep_alarm.get('repeat_days')})
print('others_to_disable', [al.get('alarm_id') for al in others])

# Update sleep alarm time (+1 hour) and ensure enabled
resp1 = apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=sleep_id, access_token=access_token, time=new_time, enabled=True)
print('update_sleep_resp', resp1)

# Disable all other alarms
update_resps=[]
for al in others:
    rid = apis.phone.update_alarm(alarm_id=al['alarm_id'], access_token=access_token, enabled=False)
    update_resps.append((al['alarm_id'], rid))
print('disable_resps', update_resps)

# Verify final states
final_alarms=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.phone.show_alarms(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if page is None or page==[]:
        break
    final_alarms.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index>50:
        break
print('final_alarm_states')
for al in final_alarms:
    print('alarm', {'alarm_id': al.get('alarm_id'), 'label': al.get('label'), 'time': al.get('time'), 'enabled': al.get('enabled')})

# Return key values for completion
final_sleep = next(al for al in final_alarms if al.get('alarm_id')==sleep_id)
final_disabled = [al.get('alarm_id') for al in final_alarms if al.get('alarm_id')!=sleep_id and not al.get('enabled')]
final_enabled_others = [al.get('alarm_id') for al in final_alarms if al.get('alarm_id')!=sleep_id and al.get('enabled')]
print('final_sleep_summary', {'alarm_id': sleep_id, 'time': final_sleep.get('time'), 'enabled': final_sleep.get('enabled')})
print('final_disabled_ok', final_disabled)
print('final_enabled_others_should_be_empty', final_enabled_others)
